name: Mons Malapert summit
note: Artemis III candidate region (Malapert Massif). Point = highest LOLA 20 m DEM pixel within 15 km (5173 m). The earlier catalogue point (-85.99, 357.07) lay on the south flank, where the massif itself hides Earth.
source: LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ peak search; IAU Mons Malapert centre -85.98, 358.33
